Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters is 0190. Hold Alt, type 0190 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters also has the Unicode codepoint U+00BE, so you can type it with Alt+190 on Windows, search for U+00BE in macOS's Character Viewer, use ¾ in HTML, or \00BE in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ¾ for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters, but the numeric form ¾ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type vulgar fraction three quarters on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 1 9 0 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters character (¾) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type vulgar fraction three quarters on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters" and click the character to insert it.

How to use vulgar fraction three quarters in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00BE"; ()
  • Python: \u00BE or chr(0xBE)
  • JavaScript: \u00BE or String.fromCodePoint(0xBE)
  • JSON: "\u00BE"
  • LaTeX: $\frac{3}{4}$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters?

The legacy Alt code for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters is 0190. Hold Alt, type 0 1 9 0 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ¾ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ¾, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+190 not work?

Alt+190 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters?

The Unicode codepoint for Vulgar Fraction Three Quarters is U+00BE. You can use this value in HTML as ¾, in CSS as \00BE, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ¾ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00BE, then click it.
